chunks: "If the crescent of Rajab is confirmed, then count fifty-nine days and fast on the sixtieth day."

key_terms.هِلَالُ: the new moon crescent marking the start of a lunar month

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instruct fasting to be calculated from the confirmed crescent of Rajab?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical legal guideline for determining a day of fasting based on the confirmed sighting of the crescent of Rajab. It reflects the role of lunar observation in regulating acts of worship in Islamic law.
